methods.label: Equal angles give equal sides
methods.explanation: The building, the horizontal ground segment, and the line of sight form a right triangle. Its other acute angle is \(90^\circ-45^\circ=45^\circ\), so the two acute angles are equal. Their opposite sides are therefore equal, giving a building height of \(40\text{ m}\).
methods.levelReason: Uses grade 8 complementary angles in a right triangle and the equal-angle criterion for an isosceles triangle.
